Developer's note checked: Cannot be judged: staging Deals Pipeline field was changed on 24 Oct to a pick list allowing only "Standard (Standard)".

Every deal write that sends a pipeline is refused — API create/PATCH on pipeline "1" and even on the default Standard id → 422 "Pipeline: '…' is not one of the allowed values (Standard (Standard))."; UI Create Transactions offers "1" and its 7 stages but Save is refused with the raw id message. No deal can be created or moved on staging, so the stage/pipeline fix cannot be verified.

Checked:

  • Stages offered = the chosen pipeline's stages → Pipeline "1" → its 7 stages offered (test-01, test-02, qualification, needs_analysis, negotiation, proposal, identify_decision_makers) [PASS]
  • Create a deal on pipeline "1" (UI) → Save → POST 422 "Pipeline: '640e03a4-…' is not one of the allowed values (Standard (Standard))." shown with the raw pipeline id [BLOCKED]
  • API create on "1"/test-01 and PATCH an existing deal to "1" → Both 422 PICKLIST_VALUE_INVALID; deal stays on Standard (21 Oct: 201 + silent switch to Standard) [BLOCKED]
  • Cause → Staging Deals Pipeline field allows only "Standard (Standard)" (changed 24 Oct by ndc-staging-owner); even the default Standard is refused, so the fix cannot be judged until the field is repaired [INFO]
  • Developer reply since our 21 Oct PARTIAL → None [INFO]

Still failing:

  • Blocked by staging config: Deals field "pipeline" = pick_list, allowed_values ["Standard (Standard)"] (modified 24 Oct 15:54 UTC by ndc-staging-owner).

Moved to Bug (QA lead decision, 26 Oct): the fix cannot be confirmed on staging. The Deals "pipeline" field is a pick list that allows only "Standard (Standard)" (changed 24 Oct 15:54 UTC by ndc-staging-owner), so no deal can be created or moved with any pipeline in the UI or the API. Please restore the field (pipeline lookup with all pipelines of the layout) and move this ticket back to Ready For Test.
